description: This file is a test class for the EmpUsTaxExemptionAPI, part of the HRM system's API testing suite, specifically testing US tax exemption functionalities within the Pim plugin. It contains multiple unit tests covering methods like getOne, update, and validation rules, as well as setup with mock objects and fixtures.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionAPITest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class extending EndpointTestCase, testing the EmpUsTaxExemptionAPI's functionalities such as retrieving, updating, validation rules, and exceptions for US tax exemption data within the OrangeHRM Pim plugin.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data from a YAML file to populate the database with initial test data for tax exemptions.

methods.name: testGetEmpUsTaxExemptionService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of EmpUsTaxExemptionService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee US tax exemption record, verifying normalization and meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the 'getOne' API endpoint, ensuring correct request validation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures delete validation rules throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee's US tax exemption record with fixture data, including verifying the save operation and normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for updating US tax exemption data.
